entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnetup` does not correctly detect SDK version from `global.json` #54874
  • `dotnetup` should retry install dl / extract or handle 503 better #54873
  • [Known Build Error] AoT macOS: WasmAoTPublishIntegrationTest fails with NETSDK1147 (wasm-tools workload not installed) #54869
  • `dotnetup` in `FullReplacement` mode breaks x86 apps #54865
  • [Known Build Error] AoT macOS build fails: GetAssemblyAttributes IOException - Microsoft.DotNet.ApiCompat.Task.dll in use by another process #54864
  • `dotnet test` in sdk repo is failing #54844
  • `dotnet publish` breaking change between 10.0.101 and 10.0.2xx/10.0.3xx: `Program does not contain a static 'Main' method` #54841
  • `dotnetup` fails with "Error: Sequence contains no elements" after successful `dotnetup init ~ Terminal Mode/Isolation Mode` #54840
  • Satellite assemblies not generated for valid neutral culture 'dv' (Divehi/Dhivehi) #54835

Closed

  • Uninstall dotnetup #54866
